allow: PowerShell(Get-ChildItem -Recurse -File popup,scripts,data,test | Where-Object { $_.FullName -notmatch 'node_modules' } | Select-Object FullName, Length | Format-Table -AutoSize)

Bash(python -c "import sys,json; rs=json.load\(sys.stdin\); print\([\(r.get\('tag_name'\),r.get\('published_at'\),r.get\('name'\)\) for r in rs[:5]]\)")

PowerShell(\(Get-Content scripts\\content.js | Measure-Object -Line\).Lines; \(Get-Content scripts\\generators.js | Measure-Object -Line\).Lines; Select-String -Path popup\\popup.html -Pattern 'script src')

Bash(node -e "const fs=require\('fs'\); const p=JSON.parse\(fs.readFileSync\('data/address-pool/japan.json','utf8'\)\); console.log\('jp',p.length, p[0]\); const us=JSON.parse\(fs.readFileSync\('data/address-pool/united-states.json','utf8'\)\); console.log\('us',us.length, us[0]\);")
Bash(node -e "const fs=require\('fs'\); for \(const f of fs.readdirSync\('data/address-pool'\)\){const a=JSON.parse\(fs.readFileSync\('data/address-pool/'+f\)\); console.log\(f, a.length\);}")
PowerShell(Get-ChildItem -Force | Where-Object { $_.Name -ne '.git' } | Select-Object Name, Mode | Format-Table -AutoSize)

PowerShell(Get-ChildItem data\\address-pool\\ | ForEach-Object { $j = Get-Content $_.FullName -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json; $cityCount = if \($j.cities\) { $j.cities.Count } elseif \($j.PSObject.Properties.Name -contains 'regions'\) { 'regions' } else { 'unknown' }; $size = $_.Length; "$\($_.Name\): $size bytes, top keys: $\($j.PSObject.Properties.Name -join ', '\)" })
